question: How do they measure style transfer success?
title: Grammatical Error Correction and Style Transfer via Zero-shot Monolingual Translation
answer_short: They measure style transfer success by calculating the root mean square error (RMSE) between human evaluator scores and desired style direction values, where +1 indicates more formal and -1 more informal.
answer_rationale: Text 4 explicitly describes the evaluation method: human evaluators assign scores (+1, -1, or 0) based on style direction, and RMSE is calculated between these scores and desired values. Text 3 and Text 7 provide supporting context on human evaluation and agreement rates, reinforcing that human evaluators are central to measuring success. Text 6 confirms that qualitative and quantitative manual evaluation is part of the methodology.
